thread.title: NEW: Federal Judge Extends Pause on Trump's Move to Put Thousands of USAID Workers on Leave | The Gateway Pundit | by Cristina Laila
thread.title_full: NEW: Federal Judge Extends Pause on Trump's Move to Put Thousands of USAID Workers on Leave | The Gateway Pundit | by Cristina Laila

author: Falcneddie
text:
I am not justifying the absolute waste that the USAID employees were told to "direct" by their Biden Superiors and even Trump Superiors in the 1st Trump administration. This has been going on forever, but for the people who took the job assignments over seas, moved their families, set-up in schools, either sold their houses or tried to rent them while they were gone, for those people to be suddenly told- find your way home when there EXISTS an agreement with the Federal government for the Federal government to return them home in an event like this, and there are certain other conditions the Feds agreed to and the people agreed to- in other words- the government has some obligations they owe these people. Namely, getting their stuff and them home if they are closing down the shops overseas. That is a basic agreement these people went over there based on in the first place.
As such, this Trump appointed Judge is obviously noticing that the Federal government has some duties to these people, at least overseas that it just can't walk out on.
I am guessing Trump is not objecting to that part of the obvious legal obligations the Administration has.
Trump does have a sense of keeping promises the Federal government makes with people. If not, well then hell even I voted for the wrong guy, but I'm guessing I did not.
Trump will do the right thing in the end, this was just a wholesale Executive order. As Musk said, they will get some stuff wrong. No one can bat 1000%.
We will be seeing a lot of this kind of stuff.
Problems will show up that no one had the time to consider when the order was written, and it'll get sued over or outright stopped by the courts until contractual agreements like even this horrible USAID program is required to fulfill to its career employees.
I do know some of those people stuck overseas had kids and a mortgage and had taken a financial beating to be over there in the first place... As Americans, we just don't dump our citizens overseas and say, find your own way home.
Again, I know Trump will do the right thing in the end.
Now, as far as the asinine political appointees from the Biden Administration, I'd prefer they find a way home themselves, but the Federal government does in fact have a contractual obligation to get them back to the states as well.
Trump will do the right thing. He's not some mean dude that doesn't care about people.
